children: Overview
US mining royalty company's Q3 net income rose to $2.2 mln from $0.2 mln
Q3 gross profit increased to $3.7 mln from $2.4 mln last year
Company declared quarterly dividend of $0.015 per share
Outlook
Company declares quarterly dividend of $0.015 per share, payable January 14, 2027
Vox says it is well capitalized to pursue further royalty acquisitions
Company expects to complete Sorby Hills silver-lead royalty acquisition in Q4 2026
Result Drivers

ROYALTY ACQUISITIONS - Co said Q3 results benefited from acquiring three Australian gold and copper royalties, including the producing White Dam royalty, and a binding agreement for the Sorby Hills silver-lead royalty
PORTFOLIO ORGANIC GROWTH - Co cited ongoing organic growth, with record quarterly royalty revenue from Kanmantoo and operational progress at Los Filos and Sugar Zone mines
STRONG CASH POSITION - Co highlighted $27 mln cash at quarter end and an upsized $100 mln credit facility as supporting future acquisition opportunities
